w10_T4_000652: A school's lost property box held 88 items on Monday, and 49 of them were claimed by pupils during the week. The office added 31 items found in the yard, and the sports hall sent over 76 more. A charity collection then took 91 items away. Every item still in the box was photographed 9 times for the online list. A dozen parents came in to look through the box. The office logs the time spent on the list in minutes rather than in hours. How many photographs were taken?
w10_T4_000655: On Monday morning a factory received 156 crates and divided them equally among its 4 assembly bays. Later that morning each crate in the first bay was opened and found to hold 5 machine parts. During the afternoon every part in that bay was fitted with 6 washers. In the evening a spare tin added 77 washers to the bay's stock. Each washer is dipped in 9 grams of grease before it goes on the line. How many grams of grease does the first bay need?
w10_T4_000658: A theatre box office was holding 90 unsold seats for Friday's show and released 25 more from the sponsors' block. 2 seats were taken out of use because of a broken armrest. A school party then booked 52 seats for its drama group. Later the manager released 30 more seats from the balcony. The theatre was built 84 years ago. How many seats are still unsold?
w10_T4_000662: On Tuesday morning a hire company had 171 deckchairs out on the beach and took 18 away for repair. Before lunch a delivery van brought 43 more down to the front. During the afternoon 122 deckchairs were hired out for the day. In the early evening the staff folded every deckchair still on the beach and tied each one with 8 straps for storage. The store cupboard held 67 spare straps and the maintenance box another 4. The company's hire slips are written in minutes rather than in hours. How many straps does the company have altogether?
w10_T4_000664: On Saturday morning a stationer had 90 boxes of pencils and split them equally between its 2 shops. In the afternoon the high street shop opened its boxes and found 4 packs inside every one. In the early evening the assistant counted 4 pencils in each pack. A late delivery added 26 loose pencils to the drawer, and 47 pencils were sold before closing. The shop's price list is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many pencils does the high street shop have?
w10_T4_000666: A cake stall started the day with 59 sponge cakes, and 16 of them were bought whole by a caterer. Every cake still on the stall was cut into 3 slices. 35 slices went across to a coffee morning, 63 were sold at the counter, and 26 were taken to the staff room. A late bake then added 63 slices to the tray. The hall clock runs 15 minutes slow. The price card is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many slices are on the tray?
w10_T4_000668: A council depot looks after 180 street lamps, and every lamp holds 9 bulbs. Each bulb is made up of 6 filaments. Over the year 5377 filaments burned out and were scrapped, and a delivery supplied 45 spare filaments. A contractor then took 4077 filaments away for another district. A dozen vans are based at the depot. How many filaments does the depot have left?
w10_T4_000669: On Friday morning a farm stand had 114 pumpkins and sold 111 of them before lunch. In the afternoon the grower brought down a second pumpkin for every one still on the stand, so the stand held 2 times as many as it had after the morning rush. In the evening each pumpkin was carved with 7 candle holes, and every hole was lined with 8 small sheets of foil. The farm shop is 5 kilometres out of town. How many sheets of foil were used?
w10_T4_000686: On Monday morning a transport company logged 189 minutes of driver training and added 32 minutes more before lunch. 26 minutes were cancelled when a trainer fell ill. In the afternoon a new safety course added 74 minutes to the schedule. The training centre charges 5 cents for every minute on the schedule, and in the evening head office decided to run the identical schedule at each of its 6 depots. A dozen drivers waited in the canteen for the news. The invoice is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents will the training cost?
w10_T4_000691: A small airline had 227 seats on the evening flight, and 196 of them were booked online. 14 more were taken at the airport desk, and 1 was blocked off for a crew member travelling home. A cancellation later released 37 seats back into the pool. The booking screen shows flight times in minutes rather than in hours. How many seats are available on the flight?
w10_T4_000694: A brickworks fired 72 racks in one week, with 4 trays on every rack and 3 bricks on every tray. A neighbour returned 25 bricks that had never been used on his extension. A garden wall job then took 529 bricks away from the yard. How many bricks are left at the works?
w10_T4_000701: On Wednesday morning a phone shop had 157 handsets in the back room and 6 more arrived at lunchtime. During the afternoon the staff put every handset on charge for 9 minutes to test it. The supplier agreed to pay for 830 of those charging minutes. In the evening the shop was billed 6 cents for each of the minutes the supplier had not covered. The bill is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents was the shop billed?
w10_T4_000704: Selma's craft stall had 178 bracelets on display and she made 22 more overnight. Her friend Ines, who makes fewer bracelets each week than Selma does, brought 53 of her own to the same stall. Every bracelet on the stall was strung with 5 charms. A spare box held 75 loose charms, and a supplier sent 78 more that morning. A dozen mirrors stood along the back of the stall. How many charms does the stall have?
w10_T4_000706: A youth band has 15 members, and each member sold 6 tickets for the summer concert. The tickets were split equally among the 3 door staff for checking. One steward's pile was matched by a second batch exactly like it, so he held twice as many as before. His pile was then divided equally among the 3 entrance lanes. Each ticket in one lane is worth 6 raffle entries on the night. The hall has 400 seats. How many raffle entries do that lane's tickets give?
w10_T4_000707: A camp kitchen had 69 tins of beans in the store and a delivery added 52 more. The weekend cookouts used 40 tins, and 17 were donated to a night shelter. Every tin still in the store holds 7 portions. A bag in the freezer holds 66 ready-made portions as well. How many portions does the camp have?
w10_T4_000710: Yara had 67 minutes of studio time on her card and topped it up with 9 more. A long take used 47 minutes and a retake used another 3. Her bandmate Cai, who books far less studio time than Yara does, borrowed 17 minutes from her card. The studio refunded her 5 minutes after a power cut, then charged her 4 minutes for cleaning. The card is sold in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes are left on Yara's card?
w10_T4_000712: A charity cycle shop had 177 helmets on the racks and sold 65 of them at the summer sale. A donor returned 7 that had never been worn. The manager, Bea, sent 52 helmets to a partner project run by Otto, whose shop keeps fewer helmets than Bea's does. A school then donated 28 helmets to the shop. A dozen bicycles stood chained outside the door. The shop's price list is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many helmets does the shop have?
w10_T4_000713: A swimming club had 110 kickboards in the pool store, and a school donated 17 more at the start of term. A supplier sent another 36 that same month. 109 kickboards were taken to the junior gala and never came back, and 4 split along the foam and were thrown away. A dozen lane ropes hang on the wall beside the store. How many kickboards are in the store?
w10_T4_000714: A festival campsite has 226 pitches, and each pitch is staked out with 7 tent pegs. 517 pegs were lost in the mud over the weekend and never found. Every peg that did come back was cleaned with 7 strokes of a wire brush, and each stroke used 3 drops of oil. The campsite is 4 kilometres from the main stage. How many drops of oil were used?
w10_T4_000719: Marek printed 240 posters for the town festival, and his colleague Lucia, who prints fewer than he does, added 61 of her own. Every poster is pinned up with 7 tacks. A spare box supplied 76 further tacks, and 952 tacks were used up on a different job across town. A returned crate then put 30 tacks back in the store. Each tack costs the festival 8 cents. A dozen rolls of tape sit on the shelf beside them. How many cents are the festival's tacks worth?
w10_T4_000723: A pet shop had 82 fish in the big tank and a delivery added 45 more. 67 fish were sold over the weekend. The owner moved half of the fish that were left into a holding tank at the back. Those fish were then shared equally among the shop's 6 window tanks. One window tank lost 3 fish to a heron when the lid was left open. The shop is open 7 days a week. How many fish are in that window tank?
w10_T4_000731: On Monday morning Freya's team cut 239 sheets of glass, and every sheet gave 6 panes. Before lunch her colleague Piotr, who cuts fewer sheets than Freya does, added 26 panes from his own bench, then 14 more, and in the early afternoon another 19. Later that afternoon a glazing contract took 1460 panes away from the workshop. In the evening 17 panes cracked while they were being loaded onto the van. How many panes are left?
w10_T4_000732: A school had 205 tablets in its charging trolley. 42 of them were sent away for repair and 128 were signed out by classes for the term. The tablets that were left were shared equally among the 5 after-school clubs. One club then had 4 of its tablets taken back by the office for an exam. The trolley itself cost 900 dollars. How many tablets does that club have?
w10_T4_000733: A car park has 52 rows with 8 bays in every row. On a busy day each bay is used 8 times over. The overflow yard next door adds 74 more uses to the day's tally. The council charges 3 cents in tax for every use, and a fixed levy of 3 cents is added to the day's bill at the end. The council ledger is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents does the car park owe for a busy day?
w10_T4_000742: On Saturday morning a repair cafe had 98 tools on the bench, and 13 of them were found broken and thrown out. Before lunch a volunteer named Hugo brought in 77 tools from a house clearance, more than his colleague Petra had brought all month, and at noon Petra added 52 of her own. During the afternoon 3 tools went missing, and a school workshop borrowed 162. In the evening a member returned 23 tools to the bench. How many tools are on the bench?
